name: texture-fill
title: Texture Fill 纹理填充
description: 带四种纹理、纯色、弹簧过渡和减少动态效果支持的装饰性百分比画布。

whenToUse: 配额数值已有文字语义，需要装饰性纹理填充背景

whenNotToUse.case: 需要自带可访问百分比语义的完整仪表

accessibility: 画布隐藏于辅助技术；调用方提供 meter 语义和缺失数据处理
responsive: 跟随容器尺寸和设备像素比，减少动态效果时立即同步读数

Adapted from `onevalar/token-plan`, `platforms/tauri/src/DitherFill.tsx`, revision c588b28cc1a19a1bdd5964db5c791e2ec66d5ec4. Also reviewed the in-progress native `src/svelte/usage/DitherFill.svelte` on 2026-11-07. Svelte effects replace React hooks; live reduced-motion changes, ancestor recoloring and explicit Canvas errors are retained/added. Application texture-choice/tint preferences are deliberately not part of this generic library primitive. No Arc source is involved.

# Texture Fill Design Rules

- Decorative percentage texture, not a meter: the caller supplies accessible quota semantics and missing-data handling.
- value is finite and clamps graphically to 0–100. texture is dither, lines, halftone, hatch or solid.
- Set an explicit container size; canvas follows ResizeObserver and device pixel ratio (capped at 3).
- intro starts at zero only when motion is allowed. Reduced motion snaps immediately, including preference changes while mounted.
- Color follows currentColor and semantic Valar tokens; do not hardcode provider palettes into the primitive.
- Every resize/theme/media observer and animation frame must be disposed on teardown or texture replacement. Canvas 2D is required; absence raises an explicit error.

export { default as TextureFill, type TextureFillProps } from "./texture-fill.svelte";
export { textures, type Texture, type FillTexture } from "./canvas.js";
